correctness.rationale: The graph is the 12-cycle with opposite matching edges. Independently constructed its 12,48,76,48,12 independent faces and mod-2 boundary ranks 11,37,36,12, yielding H2(F2) dimension3; explicit octahedral sphere cycles on three disjoint 3K2 supports form a basis mod 2, with rotation columns (3,5,1) and one unipotent Jordan block of size three. Signed fixed-face Lefschetz numbers give rational traces (3,-1,-1,-1) at rotation powers and eigenvalues (-1,i,-i), while Agarwal–Basak Theorem 12 gives integral torsion-free H2 rank3 via a wedge of three S2. A split Z[i]⊕Z_- lattice would satisfy (rho-I)^2=0 mod2, contrary to the checked block; W=ker(rho²+1) is saturated Gaussian integer rank-one, quotient is sign, and extension classes W/(rho+1)W=Z/2. Independently checked the claimed integer matrix has fourth power identity, characteristic constituents, and Smith factors (1,1,4) for rho-I. This proves precisely the integral C4 structure, not an equivariant geometric splitting.
